source.title: At the doctor's (ladder unit, machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)
source.attribution: Course-authored controlled German. Drafted by an AI model; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder; not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive German written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. The English lines are the drafter's own.
source.licenseNote: Owned by the course authors; machine-drafted, not yet native-reviewed.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. The doctor says du to Ben (a child) and Sie to Marta and Sam; Marta and Sam say Sie to the doctor. "Wie fühlen Sie sich?" and "Mir tut ... weh" are the usual forms. The prescription ("Rezept") is taken to the pharmacy. The doctor's practice is a "Praxis"; no doctor's surname is used. The medical advice is deliberately plain (bed, fluids, tablets morning and evening) and is not to be taken as advice; it needs a medical reader as well as a language reviewer.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Am Wochenende hat Ben draußen gespielt.
sentences.english: At the weekend Ben played outside.

sentences.text: Es hat geregnet, und er hatte keine Jacke.
sentences.english: It rained, and he had no jacket.

sentences.text: Er hat auch den Regenschirm verloren.
Jetzt hat er Fieber, und das Ohr tut weh.
sentences.english: Now he has a fever, and his ear hurts.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Ich rufe in der Praxis an.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: I would like an appointment, please.

sentences.text: Die Praxis hat heute um zehn Uhr einen Termin.
sentences.english: The practice has an appointment today at ten o'clock.

sentences.text: Marta und Ben fahren mit dem Bus.
sentences.english: Marta and Ben take the bus.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Yes, I am coming along, Ben.

sentences.text: Sie steigen in den Bus ein.
Im Bus bekommen sie einen Platz.
sentences.english: On the bus they get a seat.

sentences.text: Marta hat keinen Koffer, nur eine Tasche.
sentences.english: Marta has no suitcase, only a bag.

sentences.text: Sie steigen aus, und die Praxis ist da.
sentences.english: They get off, and the practice is there.
The doctor is sitting in the office.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Er hat eine Erkältung, das ist nicht schön.
sentences.english: He has a cold, that is not nice.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Mir tut das Ohr weh, und der Kopf auch.
sentences.english: My ear hurts, and my head too.

sentences.speaker: arztin
sentences.text: Lass mich auch dein Auge sehen.
sentences.english: Let me see your eye too.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Nein, aber der Fuß tut weh, vom Fahrrad.
sentences.english: No, but my foot hurts, from the bicycle.

sentences.speaker: arztin
sentences.text: Was hast du am Wochenende gemacht?
sentences.english: What did you do at the weekend?

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich war im Kino und habe Pizza gegessen.
sentences.english: I was at the cinema and ate pizza.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich war glücklich, aber dann habe ich draußen gespielt.
sentences.english: I was happy, but then I played outside.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Ich habe geweint, und leider war mir auch kalt.
sentences.english: I cried, and unfortunately I was cold too.

sentences.speaker: ben
sentences.text: Meine Jacke ist neu, aber ich habe sie verloren.
sentences.english: My jacket is new, but I lost it.

sentences.speaker: arztin
sentences.text: Du hast Fieber, und du hast Schmerzen im Ohr.
sentences.english: You have a fever, and you have pain in your ear.

sentences.speaker: arztin
sentences.text: Das Medikament ist für die Schmerzen.
sentences.english: The medicine is for the pain.

sentences.speaker: arztin
sentences.text: Du sollst das Medikament am Morgen und am Abend nehmen.
sentences.english: You should take the medicine in the morning and in the evening.

sentences.speaker: arztin
sentences.text: Du musst im Bett bleiben und genug Wasser und Tee trinken.
sentences.english: You must stay in bed and drink enough water and tea.

sentences.speaker: arztin
sentences.text: Und du sollst nicht in die Schule gehen.
sentences.english: And you should not go to school.

sentences.text: Marta und Ben gehen in die Apotheke.
sentences.english: Marta and Ben go to the pharmacy.

sentences.text: Zu Hause legt sich Ben ins Bett.
sentences.english: At home Ben lies down in bed.

sentences.text: Marta kocht Suppe und Tee, und Ben lacht wieder.
sentences.english: Marta cooks soup and tea, and Ben laughs again.

sentences.text: Am Dienstag ist auch Sam in der Praxis.
sentences.english: On Tuesday Sam is in the practice too.

sentences.text: Er hat Fieber, und der Hals tut weh.
sentences.english: He has a fever, and his throat hurts.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Der Hals tut weh, und ich habe Fieber.
sentences.english: My throat hurts, and I have a fever.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Ich habe auch Schmerzen im Hals.
sentences.english: I also have pain in my throat.

sentences.speaker: arztin
sentences.english: Were you outside at the weekend?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Ja, wir waren am See, und es hat geregnet.
sentences.english: Yes, we were at the lake, and it rained.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Ja, gestern habe ich im Büro von Thomas gearbeitet.
sentences.english: Yes, yesterday I worked in Thomas's office.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I had a lot of work.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Ich habe im Supermarkt eingekauft, die Wohnung geputzt, die Wäsche gemacht und geduscht.
sentences.english: I did the shopping at the supermarket, cleaned the flat, did the washing and showered.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Das Abendessen war fertig, aber ich habe nichts gegessen.
sentences.english: Dinner was ready, but I ate nothing.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: The day before yesterday I was still well.

sentences.speaker: arztin
sentences.text: Nein, Sie können zu Fuß gehen.
Sam ist zurück bei Frau Weber.
sentences.english: Sam is back at Mrs Weber's.

sentences.speaker: weber
sentences.english: I will not let you go.

sentences.text: Frau Weber lässt Sam im Bett schlafen.
sentences.english: Mrs Weber lets Sam sleep in bed.
